summary: Tested the login fix and the L08 LN-081 sales-return timeline/journey-scan feature on the preview URL. Login through the UI works (admin@ / demo12345 lands on ?view=admin-home). No requests went to localhost, and the built bundle has no localhost:8001 string. Backend tests/test_l08_ln081_journey.py: 4/4 passed. UI: created return SRET-00008 from KSC/SO-00001 via API (notes TEST_L081_UI, approved), then opened it in ?view=returns&entity=ent_ksc. The return-timeline-panel renders the summary (timeline-unit-yard: claim 115 yard, 1 roll, value basis note), the rolls table and the events. Full scan flow worked through the UI: received@Jakarta (TRM-1) -> dispatched to Rancamalang Transit (SJ-1, location 'Dalam perjalanan ...') -> arrived Transit (TBA-1) -> dispatched to Gudang Retur (SJ-2) -> arrived (TBA-2, location 'Area QC · ...'). timeline-roll-location-<rollId> updated after each scan and showed 5 inbound-lane events with doc numbers. The UI showed the right Indonesian error for each negative test: unknown code, receiving twice, arriving at the wrong warehouse. API checks: cross-entity warehouse -> 403, dispatch without destination -> 400, unknown stage -> 400, empty codes -> 400, no auth -> 401, other-entity user -> 404. Test data cleaned up (return deleted, roll restored to delivered@wh_jakarta).

issues: The warehouse dropdowns list every warehouse, including other entities' warehouses (e.g. Soreang · Gudang Kanda). The backend then rejects them with 403. Better to filter the options to warehouses usable by ret.entity_id.
When stage=dispatched, the submit button is enabled even if no destination is chosen. The backend returns 400 'Pilih gudang tujuan pengiriman.' The button could be disabled until toWh is set.

The older ReturnJourneyPanel ('Perjalanan Barang') still has manual 'Tandai sekarang' / 'Perbarui tanggal' buttons for 'Barang sampai' / 'SJ Kirim Toko', next to the new scan-based timeline. Two parallel 'journey' UIs may confuse users. A manual goods_arrived milestone also shows up in the inbound lane even though no roll was scanned. Consider hiding or deprecating these buttons once the scan journey is used.

action_items: Optional UX: filter scan warehouse options by entity usability
Optional UX: disable journey-scan-submit when stage=dispatched and no destination is selected
Optional: reconcile the old manual 'Barang sampai' milestone buttons with the scan-only location rule
critical_code_review_comments: return_journey_service.scan: one scan containing rolls in mixed stages fails as a whole. That is fine, but the error only names the first failing roll.
ReturnTimelinePanel loads /api/warehouses without passing the entity scope, which is why the options include other entities' warehouses.
